Using double machine learning, which residualises both sales and price on temperature, cost and weekday and then regresses the sales residuals on the price residuals, the estimated ATE of price on sales is about -4.00.

scikit-learn wasn't installed, so I used linear nuisance models instead of a flexible learner such as gradient boosting. This is the same partialling-out step, equivalent to OLS of sales on price plus temperature, cost and weekday dummies.

The naive regression of sales on price gives +1.23. That has the wrong sign because the observational prices are confounded.

I did not check this against the randomised test set.

ANSWER: -4.00
